title: Petra & Aes

subjects.name: Petra & Aes, War Drums of Meraxis

problem: rank 70 adds a flat 15% of Speed
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "potency increased by 15% of Speed". Fix: H: Petra & Aes rank 70: add 15% of Speed to the potency (before Defense and modifiers) instead of a flat add to the final amount, in all three calculators. vs bugged: stronger against low Defense, weaker against high. 2026-10-26 hook batch B2: left needs-hook. The rank-70 flat add sits after Defense and the modifiers in three calculators (bc_SpellDamage 0x14163c5df, bc_SpellHealing 0x141650f85, bc_SpellStat 0x14165e7b7). Moving it into the potency means removing the flat add and adding 15% of Speed to each calculator's potency stat; the potency-stat read sites and the removal were not decoded in this batch. | 2026-10-26 hook batch F1 built (research/hooks_F1.json, loader/hooks_F1.c). Left needs-hook. Plan: move the rank-70 flat add (bc_SpellDamage L2297 @0x14163c5df, crit_speed x 0.15 at L2298; healing @0x141650f85; stat @0x14165e7b7) into the stat-bonus pool the way Swiftcasting (364, damage L415-L417) adds its stat, and skip the flat add. Not built: the pool and Speed locals of the three calculators were not decoded in this batch. | 2026-10-26 patched (hooks_G4, SU-0109): in bc_SpellDamage (L437), bc_SpellHealing (L193) and bc_SpellStat (L232) the scr_Diminish(stat, pool) call that folds the casting-stat bonus pool into the casting stat is hooked. With scr_CritHasRelicPerk(caster, 8, 7) (the game's own Petra & Aes rank 70 gate), 15% of crit_speed(caster) joins the pool, the same place Swiftcasting's 35% of Speed goes. The old flat add to the final amount (damage L2297, healing / stat gates) is skipped (je -> jmp). The bonus now goes through Defense and every potency modifier like the rest of the casting stat. In-game test: a creature with Petra & Aes at rank 70 and high Speed; its damage spells against a high-Defense enemy, its heals and its stat-spell amounts all rise with Speed in proportion (compare with the relic below rank 70), and no longer add a fixed amount on top; spells without the relic are unchanged.

release_notes.intended: The potency of the bearer's spells is increased by 15% of its Speed.
release_notes.actual: The game added a flat amount (15% of Speed) to the spell's final number, after Defense and potency modifiers.
release_notes.fix: Now the 15% of Speed is added to the stat the spell is based on (like Swiftcasting), so it goes through Defense and potency modifiers.
